itemListElement.name: Starter
itemListElement.description: Starting price. Best for one property or one flip, single entity. Monthly transaction categorization, reconciliation, P&L, and balance sheet.

itemListElement.name: Growth
itemListElement.description: Starting price. Best for 2 to 7 properties, several flips a year, or multiple entities. Includes multi-property reporting, AP/AR, rent roll reconciliation, and tax prep support.

itemListElement.name: Premium
itemListElement.description: Starting price. Best for 8+ properties, active portfolios, short-term rentals, and development projects. Includes monthly check-in calls, priority support, depreciation schedules, and payroll support.
